scope: Milestone C: the recorded neighbouring-clearance construction re-run unchanged to add per-group canonical vertex counts, accepted edits and time. Conforming counts are expected to reproduce the manifest exactly, and the per-city totals double as the calibration between this machine and the one the manifests were measured on.
measurement_environment: Linux aarch64 virtual machine on the author's workstation, not the repository's macOS .venv. Library and mesher revisions match; absolute timings are therefore not comparable with earlier manifests, and a calibration sample is recorded separately.

censoring.reading: Every fit below is a lower bound on growth: the cap removes exactly the work the largest groups would otherwise do.
